title: Qwen3.8
before: Qwen3.5 and 3.6 had kept the family current through the first half of 2026.
problem: Open releases now have to match a monthly closed-model cadence.
breakthrough: The latest Qwen generation, with a preview of the next architecture.
why: Qwen remains the most widely downloaded and fine-tuned open family.
next: The Qwen4 architecture previewed alongside it.
inherits: An Apache-licensed open baseline that keeps pace.
